mobile.projects.delete_body.note: Destructive confirmation. Placeholder {name} is the project's display name (user text, may contain spaces). Both halves are load-bearing: what the delete destroys and what it leaves alone.

mobile.projects.draft_kept_note.note: Tells the reader a dismissed form kept their unfinished work and how to discard it. Applies to both the create sheet and the milestone editor.

mobile.projects.milestone_slash_note.note: Explains why a milestone name may not contain a slash. Names the consequence the reader can act on; never mention routes, paths or encoding.

mobile.projects.milestones.count.note: Milestone progress from the relay's own two counts. {completed} and {total} are non-negative integers and both must survive translation. ENGLISH needs no plural agreement because its noun is fixed to the count phrase; a locale whose noun agrees with the completed count must pluralize on {completed} (French: one/many/other) and keep {total} a plain placeholder inside every branch — the generator fails a translation that drops or retypes either name.

mobile.projects.milestones.none.note: Lower-case fragment shown where a milestone count would go when the relay reports zero total milestones. It is joined with a session count, so it carries no final full stop.

mobile.projects.project_name_hint.note: The complete project-name grammar stated before the tap. Length range and allowed characters must stay exact: this sentence is the reader's only warning before a refusal.

mobile.projects.remove_milestone_body.note: Destructive confirmation. Placeholder {name} is the milestone name (user text, may contain spaces). Says what goes and what stays.

mobile.projects.session_state.filed_by.note: Lower-case two-word fragment marking a coordination row: the session filed the work rather than doing it. Never imply the row is a worker.

mobile.projects.session_state.missing.note: Lower-case word for a linked session whose directory is gone. The link is still listed; this names its state.

mobile.projects.session_state.not_runnin.note: Lower-case replacement for the relay's 'stopped' runtime state. The ordinary end of a session, not an error.

mobile.projects.sessions.count.note: Session count. {count} is a non-negative integer and drives the plural category; # is that number. The zero case is 'other' in English.

mobile.projects.sessions.live.note: Appends the live-session count to a session-count phrase. {base} is the already-rendered count phrase; {live} is a positive integer. Shown only when at least one session is live.

mobile.projects.stale_badge.note: One badge word pair naming WHAT is stale (progress) rather than the project. Lower case; it sits beside a project name.

mobile.projects.write_receipt.note: One-line success receipt. THREE PARAMETERS, all supplied by the screen: {action} is a stable CODE (created, completed, reopened, added, updated, removed, deleted) and never a rendered word — the catalogue turns it into the verb; {subject} is the BARE NAME of the thing acted on (user text, never a phrase such as 'milestone X', because a phrase composed in one language cannot be ordered or inflected by another); {kind} is a stable CODE for WHAT the subject names (project, milestone, other). Each locale supplies its own noun and its own word order — English verb-first, French naming the thing first with the participle last — which is why the action arms are repeated inside every kind arm: a locale has to be free to move the verb. other catches an unknown kind or an unknown action code. Ends with a full stop.

mobile.projects.write_unknown_note.note: Shown when a write got no answer. Must state that the outcome is UNKNOWN, never that nothing was saved.
